ruling_2026-09-14: ONE_HOP_STRUCTURAL_VOTE = CLOSED (served OUT/full vote canonical; UND_NONHUB full = MetaQA diagnostic only; mass-conserving and support-normalised votes rejected). design.static: TM(v) = {(P(u), rho)} over admissible typed STRUCT edges (out-edges for all v; in-edges for non-hub v, frozen cap rule) -- precomputed from edge IDs, like the served membership table
design.query: R(q) = set of relation labels in the frozen typed-path rule's schedule (results/L1_P90_EXPLOIT/_uni_<cache>.npz 'orders'; lexical match of relation labels in the question, entity mention masked); order ignored; empty -> served ranking
design.runtime: per channel, hit v at rank r: base blocks (own + out-neighbour, served) w_r each; compat blocks {b : (b,rho) in TM(v), rho in R(q)} w_r each; a block in both gets 2 w_r; frozen rr(S)+rr(M), frozen RRF K0=60 over dense+splade, P50; exposure = 50 core blocks
design.gate: typed graph only (>= 2 relation labels, the frozen P90 typed-graph test); squad/musique (single label) are served by construction and are run as the check
arms: A0 served (asserted == frozen partition_ranking and served evidence)
design.why_membership_level_not_block_level: a per-block relation-count signature is a node-type composition (movie-rich vs person-rich blocks) and cannot separate 'movies X starred in' from 'movies X directed' -- both are movie blocks; that distinction lives on the relation label of the hit -> block membership, which is the static signature scored here

population: DEV_A only (metaqa, metaqa_phg; squad, squad_phg, musique as identity checks). DEV_B NOT read (spent twice). Transfer population for a surviving candidate = WebQSP once the PHG lane runs.
metrics: median worst gold block rank (reached-failed, all-reached)
exact McNemar vs A0 and vs A1

decision_rule.CANDIDATE: on BOTH metaqa (MtK) and metaqa_phg DEV_A: BASE_ALL R1 vs A0 gained > lost with exact McNemar p < 0.01, AND hop2+hop3 pooled R1 vs A0 gained > lost with p < 0.05, AND squad/squad_phg/musique identical to A0 (0 gained / 0 lost)
decision_rule.if_CANDIDATE: freeze the module (this sha); no DEV_B read; wait for the WebQSP transfer population; no variant tuning
decision_rule.else: NOT_CONFIRMED -> route 2: MetaQA multi-hop conceded to dynamic relation reasoning (L3); no further weighting / kernel / halo / PATH / RRF variants at L1

secondary_expectations_not_gating: blocks voted per query well below A1's ~350
no_parameters: compat weight = w_r (the served per-membership weight, undivided per the closed A2/A3 finding); no threshold, no constant, no tuning on results; the only variant run is the one above
